name: Howard Zinn
summary: Zinn wrote history from the standpoint of ordinary people and social movements. His own texts call for free universal health care, progressive taxation, workplace and neighborhood control through cooperatives, and radical change by nonviolent organizing. He rejected war as morally unjustifiable and criticised U.S. empire and the Soviet system alike.
